```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("Code", "00_setup.R"))
source(here::here("Code", "01_functions.R"))
source(here::here("Code", "02_plot_style.R"))
library(knitr)
theme_set(theme_report())
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

read_table <- function(file) fread(file.path(dir_tables, file), encoding = "UTF-8")
fmt <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
ci <- function(estimate, low, high, digits = 2) {
  sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", fmt(estimate, digits), fmt(low, digits), fmt(high, digits))
}
# Very wide confidence limits are written as long integers; read them as numbers
as_numeric_columns <- function(dt, pattern) {
  columns <- grep(pattern, names(dt), value = TRUE)
  dt[, (columns) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = columns]
  dt[]
}
# The synergy index has no useful interval when the sum of the two single
# excesses is close to zero
ci_measure <- function(measure, estimate, low, high, digits = 3) {
  ifelse(measure == "S" & (is.na(low) | high / low > 1e3),
         paste(fmt(estimate, digits), "(interval not informative)"),
         ci(estimate, low, high, digits))
}
main_or <- read_table("models_main_or.csv")
main_int <- as_numeric_columns(read_table("models_main_interaction.csv"), "^(estimate|low|high)$")
grid <- as_numeric_columns(read_table("models_grid.csv"), "^(estimate|low|high|or)_")
continuous <- read_table("models_ozone_continuous.csv")

heatwave_main <- get_param("models", "heatwave_main")
ozone_flag_main <- unique(main_or$ozone)
cause_labels <- c(
  non_accidental = "Non-accidental", cardiopulmonary = "Cardiopulmonary",
  cardiovascular = "Cardiovascular", ischemic_heart = "Ischemic heart disease",
  acute_myocardial_infarction = "Acute myocardial infarction",
  hypertensive = "Hypertensive diseases", cerebrovascular = "Cerebrovascular",
  ischemic_stroke = "Ischemic stroke", hemorrhagic_stroke = "Hemorrhagic stroke",
  respiratory = "Respiratory", copd = "COPD"
)
term_labels <- c(hw = "Heatwave", oz = "High ozone", e10 = "Heatwave only (E10)",
                 e01 = "High ozone only (E01)", e11 = "Heatwave and high ozone (E11)")
model_labels <- c(heatwave = "Heatwave alone", ozone = "Ozone alone", joint = "Joint",
                  compound = "Compound categories")
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## Preliminary

These results use working definitions that the principal investigator has not
confirmed: heatwave `r heatwave_main`, high ozone `r ozone_flag_main` (the
delivered 24-hour mean, whose limits are shown on the
[ozone validation page](03_ozone_validation.html)). They show that the pipeline
runs from the death records to the interaction measures and how much the
answer depends on the definitions. They are not findings to cite.
:::

## Models

For each death the day of death is compared with the control days of the same
municipality, year, month and day of the week, by conditional logistic
regression, at single-day lags 0 to 3:

| Model | Linear predictor | Reads as |
|---|---|---|
| Heatwave alone | β₁ HW | Odds ratio of death on a heatwave day |
| Ozone alone | β₂ O3high | Odds ratio of death on a high-ozone day |
| Joint | β₁ HW + β₂ O3high | Each exposure adjusted for the other |
| Compound categories | β₁₀ E10 + β₀₁ E01 + β₁₁ E11 | Heatwave only, high ozone only and both, against neither |

Additive interaction comes from the compound model:
REOI = OR₁₁ − OR₁₀ − OR₀₁ + 1, AP = REOI / OR₁₁ and
S = (OR₁₁ − 1) / [(OR₁₀ − 1) + (OR₀₁ − 1)], with delta-method intervals.
The multiplicative ratio OR₁₁ / (OR₁₀ × OR₀₁) is reported next to them.

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| file: ../Code/30_models_main.R
#| code-summary: "Code/30_models_main.R"
```

#| label: warnings
n_warn_main <- main_or[!is.na(fit_warnings) & fit_warnings != "", .N]
n_warn_grid <- grid[!is.na(fit_warnings) & fit_warnings != "", .N]
not_estimable <- grid[estimable == FALSE, .N]

Fits with a warning from the optimiser: `r n_warn_main` rows of the headline
tables and `r n_warn_grid` cells of the definition grid. Grid cells without

## Non-accidental mortality, working definitions

```{r}
#| label: tbl-main
#| tbl-cap: "Odds ratios (95% confidence interval) for non-accidental mortality by lag."
headline <- main_or[outcome == "non_accidental" & subgroup == "all"]
headline[, `:=`(Model = model_labels[model], Term = term_labels[term],
                value = ci(or, or_low, or_high, 3))]
kable(dcast(headline, factor(Model, levels = model_labels) + factor(Term, levels = term_labels) ~ lag,
            value.var = "value"),
      col.names = c("Model", "Term", "Lag 0", "Lag 1", "Lag 2", "Lag 3"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-main-deaths
#| tbl-cap: "Deaths by exposure category on the lagged day, non-accidental mortality."
counts <- unique(headline[, .(lag, deaths, deaths_e00, deaths_e10, deaths_e01, deaths_e11)])
kable(counts, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
      col.names = c("Lag", "Deaths", "Neither (E00)", "Heatwave only (E10)",
                    "High ozone only (E01)", "Both (E11)"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-main
#| fig-cap: "Odds ratios of non-accidental death by exposure category and lag, compound model. Bars are 95% confidence intervals."
#| fig-height: 3.6
compound <- headline[model == "compound"]
compound[, category := factor(c(e10 = "Heatwave only", e01 = "High ozone only",
                                e11 = "Heatwave and high ozone")[term],
                              levels = c("High ozone only", "Heatwave only", "Heatwave and high ozone"))]
ggplot(compound, aes(factor(lag), or, colour = category)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = ink$axis) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = or_low, ymax = or_high), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                  linewidth = 0.6, size = 0.35) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colour_compound[levels(compound$category)]) +
  labs(x = "Lag (days)", y = "Odds ratio", colour = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: headline-text
h0 <- headline[lag == 0 & model == "compound"]
r_main <- main_int[outcome == "non_accidental" & subgroup == "all" & measure == "REOI"]
```

With the working definitions, on the day of exposure the odds of non-accidental
death are `r ci(h0[term == "e10", or], h0[term == "e10", or_low], h0[term == "e10", or_high])`
times higher on heatwave-only days, `r ci(h0[term == "e01", or], h0[term == "e01", or_low], h0[term == "e01", or_high])`
on high-ozone-only days and `r ci(h0[term == "e11", or], h0[term == "e11", or_low], h0[term == "e11", or_high])`
on days with both, each against days with neither. The associations weaken
with the lag. The joint odds ratio is close to what the two single excesses
add up to: the REOI interval includes zero at every lag
(`r paste(sprintf("lag %d: %s", r_main$lag, ci(r_main$estimate, r_main$low, r_main$high, 3)), collapse = "; ")`).

### Additive interaction

```{r}
#| label: tbl-interaction
#| tbl-cap: "Interaction between heatwave and high ozone, non-accidental and cardiopulmonary mortality. REOI and AP have null value 0; S and the multiplicative ratio have null value 1."
interaction <- main_int[outcome %in% c("non_accidental", "cardiopulmonary") & subgroup == "all"]
interaction[, value := ci_measure(measure, estimate, low, high)]
interaction[, Outcome := cause_labels[outcome]]
kable(dcast(interaction, factor(Outcome, levels = cause_labels[1:2]) +
              factor(measure, levels = c("REOI", "AP", "S", "multiplicative ratio")) ~ lag,
            value.var = "value"),
      col.names = c("Outcome", "Measure", "Lag 0", "Lag 1", "Lag 2", "Lag 3"))
```

## By cause of death

```{r}
#| label: fig-causes
#| fig-cap: "Odds ratios by cause of death and exposure category, lags 0 and 1, compound model. Bars are 95% confidence intervals."
#| fig-height: 6.2
causes <- main_or[subgroup == "all" & model == "compound" & lag %in% 0:1]
causes[, category := factor(c(e10 = "Heatwave only", e01 = "High ozone only",
                              e11 = "Heatwave and high ozone")[term],
                            levels = c("High ozone only", "Heatwave only", "Heatwave and high ozone"))]
causes[, cause := factor(cause_labels[outcome], levels = rev(cause_labels))]
ggplot(causes, aes(or, cause, colour = category)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = ink$axis) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = or_low, xmax = or_high), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                  linewidth = 0.5, size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~paste("Lag", lag)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colour_compound[levels(causes$category)]) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio (log scale)", y = NULL, colour = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-reoi-causes
#| fig-cap: "Relative excess odds due to interaction (REOI) by cause of death and lag. Bars are 95% confidence intervals; zero means no additive interaction."
#| fig-height: 5.4
reoi <- main_int[subgroup == "all" & measure == "REOI"]
reoi[, cause := factor(cause_labels[outcome], levels = rev(cause_labels))]
ggplot(reoi, aes(estimate, cause)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = ink$axis) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = low, xmax = high), colour = ramp_blue[6], linewidth = 0.5, size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~paste("Lag", lag), nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "REOI", y = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-causes
#| tbl-cap: "Compound model by cause of death: deaths, odds ratios and REOI with 95% confidence intervals."
cause_table <- merge(
  dcast(main_or[subgroup == "all" & model == "compound"], outcome + lag + deaths + deaths_e11 ~ term,
        value.var = c("or", "or_low", "or_high")),
  main_int[subgroup == "all" & measure == "REOI", .(outcome, lag, reoi = estimate, reoi_low = low, reoi_high = high)],
  by = c("outcome", "lag")
)
cause_table <- cause_table[, .(
  Cause = factor(cause_labels[outcome], levels = cause_labels), Lag = lag, Deaths = deaths,
  `Deaths in E11` = deaths_e11,
  `Heatwave only` = ci(or_e10, or_low_e10, or_high_e10),
  `High ozone only` = ci(or_e01, or_low_e01, or_high_e01),
  `Both` = ci(or_e11, or_low_e11, or_high_e11),
  REOI = ci(reoi, reoi_low, reoi_high)
)][order(Cause, Lag)]
kableExtra::scroll_box(
  kableExtra::kable_styling(kable(cause_table, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ",")),
                            bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 12),
  height = "420px"

```

## By age and sex

```{r}
#| label: fig-subgroups
#| fig-cap: "Non-accidental mortality by age group and sex: odds ratio of days with both exposures (E11) and REOI, by lag. Bars are 95% confidence intervals."
#| fig-height: 4.6
sub_or <- main_or[outcome == "non_accidental" & subgroup != "all" & model == "compound" & term == "e11",
                  .(subgroup, lag, measure = "Odds ratio, E11", estimate = or,
                    low = or_low, high = or_high, null = 1)]
sub_reoi <- main_int[outcome == "non_accidental" & subgroup != "all" & measure == "REOI",
                     .(subgroup, lag, measure = "REOI", estimate, low, high, null = 0)]
subgroups <- rbind(sub_or, sub_reoi)
subgroups[, subgroup := factor(subgroup, levels = c("0-64", "65-84", "85+", "female", "male"),
                               labels = c("0-64 years", "65-84 years", "85 years or more", "Women", "Men"))]
ggplot(subgroups, aes(factor(lag), estimate)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = null), colour = ink$axis) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), colour = ramp_blue[6], linewidth = 0.5, size = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(measure ~ subgroup, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Lag (days)", y = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-subgroup-tests
#| tbl-cap: "Difference between subgroups in the log odds ratio of the compound exposure (E11): two-sample z-test against the first subgroup of each pair."
e11 <- main_or[outcome == "non_accidental" & model == "compound" & term == "e11" & subgroup != "all",
               .(subgroup, lag, log_or, se)]
pairs <- list(c("0-64", "65-84"), c("0-64", "85+"), c("female", "male"))
tests <- rbindlist(lapply(pairs, function(pair) {
  d <- merge(e11[subgroup == pair[1]], e11[subgroup == pair[2]], by = "lag", suffixes = c("_a", "_b"))
  d[, .(comparison = paste(pair[2], "against", pair[1]), lag,
        ratio_of_odds_ratios = exp(log_or_b - log_or_a),
        z = (log_or_b - log_or_a) / sqrt(se_a^2 + se_b^2))][
    , p_value := 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))]
}))
kable(tests, digits = c(0, 0, 3, 2, 3),
      col.names = c("Comparison", "Lag", "Ratio of odds ratios", "z", "p"))
```

## Across the grid of definitions

The compound model was fitted for every combination of the 15 heatwave
definitions, the three ozone series, the two interpolation methods and the
three cut-offs, at each lag. The figure shows the REOI for non-accidental
mortality with the IDW series; a dot marks the cells whose 95% interval
excludes zero. The colour scale stops at ±0.15: the few cells beyond it, all
in the rarest heatwave definitions, are drawn at the limit.

```{r}
#| label: fig-grid
#| fig-cap: "REOI for non-accidental mortality across heatwave definitions (rows) and ozone definitions (columns), by lag, IDW series."
#| fig-height: 13
#| fig-width: 9
g <- grid[outcome == "non_accidental" & grepl("_idw_", ozone) & estimable == TRUE]
g[, series := factor(sub("_idw_gt_p[0-9]+$", "", ozone), levels = c("o3", "o3obs", "o3mda8"),
                     labels = c("Delivered 24 h", "Rebuilt 24 h", "Rebuilt MDA8"))]
g[, cutoff := paste0("> P", sub(".*_gt_p", "", ozone))]
g[, heatwave := factor(heatwave, levels = rev(unique(grid$heatwave)))]
g[, excludes_zero := low_reoi > 0 | high_reoi < 0]
limit <- 0.15
ggplot(g, aes(cutoff, heatwave, fill = estimate_reoi)) +
  geom_tile(colour = ink$surface, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = g[excludes_zero == TRUE], size = 1.2, colour = ink$primary) +
  facet_grid(paste("Lag", lag) ~ series) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = diverging[["low"]], mid = diverging[["mid"]], high = diverging[["high"]],
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-limit, limit), oob = scales::squish, name = "REOI") +
  labs(x = "Ozone cut-off (municipality percentile)", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), legend.position = "right",
        legend.justification = "center")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-grid-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Definition grid, summary by outcome and lag: number of fitted cells, range of the REOI and cells whose 95% interval excludes zero."
grid_summary <- grid[estimable == TRUE, .(
  cells = .N, median_reoi = median(estimate_reoi), min_reoi = min(estimate_reoi),
  max_reoi = max(estimate_reoi), above_zero = sum(low_reoi > 0), below_zero = sum(high_reoi < 0)
), keyby = .(outcome, lag)]
grid_summary[, outcome := cause_labels[outcome]]
kable(grid_summary, digits = 3,
      col.names = c("Outcome", "Lag", "Cells", "Median REOI", "Lowest REOI", "Highest REOI",
                    "Interval above zero", "Interval below zero"))
```

With `r grid[estimable == TRUE, .N]` cells and no correction for multiple
comparisons, about `r round(0.05 * grid[estimable == TRUE, .N])` intervals would
exclude zero by chance alone. The full grid is in `Output/Tables/models_grid.csv`.

### Where the positive cells are

```{r}
#| label: tbl-grid-threshold
#| tbl-cap: "Non-accidental mortality: share of grid cells (%) whose REOI interval lies above zero, by heatwave threshold and lag, with the median REOI."
by_threshold <- grid[estimable == TRUE & outcome == "non_accidental", .(
  cells = .N, above_zero_pct = 100 * mean(low_reoi > 0), median_reoi = median(estimate_reoi)
), by = .(threshold = sub("^hw_(.*)_[0-9]d$", "\\1", heatwave), lag)]
by_threshold[, threshold := factor(threshold, levels = c("p90", "p95", "p99", "30c", "ehf"),
                                   labels = c("> P90", "> P95", "> P99", "> 30 °C", "EHF > 0"))]
kable(dcast(by_threshold, threshold ~ lag, value.var = c("above_zero_pct", "median_reoi")),
      digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 3, 3, 3, 3),
      col.names = c("Heatwave threshold", paste("% above zero, lag", 0:3), paste("Median REOI, lag", 0:3)))
```

At lags 0 and 1 the grid shows no additive interaction under any definition.
At lags 2 and 3 many intervals lie above zero, and they are concentrated in
the definitions with the fixed 30 °C threshold and the excess heat factor,
while the 95th and 99th percentile definitions show almost none. This is not
yet evidence of synergy. Each model looks at one lag at a time, so the
exposure of two or three days earlier is not separated from the heat of the
days that followed, and days with both exposures belong to longer and hotter
spells than heatwave-only days. Models with the lags fitted together
(distributed lag models) and with temperature intensity in the model are
needed before this pattern is interpreted.

## Ozone as a continuous exposure

```{r}
#| label: fig-continuous
#| fig-cap: "Odds ratio of non-accidental death per 10 ppb of ozone, by ozone series and lag, IDW, adjusted for the working heatwave indicator. Bars are 95% confidence intervals."
#| fig-height: 3.6
cont <- continuous[outcome == "non_accidental" & adjustment != "none" & grepl("_idw$", series)]
cont[, series := factor(sub("_idw$", "", series), levels = c("o3", "o3obs", "o3mda8"),
                        labels = names(colour_series))]
ggplot(cont, aes(factor(lag), or, colour = series)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = ink$axis) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = or_low, ymax = or_high), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                  linewidth = 0.6, size = 0.35) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colour_series) +
  labs(x = "Lag (days)", y = "Odds ratio per 10 ppb", colour = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-continuous
#| tbl-cap: "Odds ratio per 10 ppb of ozone (95% confidence interval), by outcome, series, adjustment and lag."
cont_table <- copy(continuous)[, value := ci(or, or_low, or_high, 3)]
cont_table[, outcome := cause_labels[outcome]]
kableExtra::scroll_box(
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    kable(dcast(cont_table, outcome + series + adjustment ~ lag, value.var = "value"), format = "html",
          col.names = c("Outcome", "Ozone series", "Adjusted for", "Lag 0", "Lag 1", "Lag 2", "Lag 3")),
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 12),
  height = "380px"
)
```

A 10 ppb step is not the same contrast in the three series: the MDA8 is about
twice the 24-hour mean and varies about twice as much from day to day.
